lead.title: Siemens Healthineers stops selling general-imaging ultrasound systems to refocus on procedural ultrasound
lead.deck: Since October 12, 2026, the group no longer sells its Acuson Sequoia, Redwood, Juniper and Maple lines, but keeps the Acuson Origin, P500 (ICE) and Freestyle, sold mainly to electrophysiologists and interventional cardiologists, with service for the installed base. A major player judges general ultrasound already well served and bets on imaging built into the therapeutic procedure.

milestone.title: Centinel Spine wins FDA approval for two-level cervical use of prodisc C Nova
milestone.summary: The cervical total disc replacement, with flat endplates and low-profile keels, can now be implanted at two levels. Centinel now has three cervical discs (prodisc C Nova, C SK, C Vivo) approved for one and two levels; the C Nova, used outside the US since 2009, is in limited release in the US.
milestone.why: The broader indication comes as Centinel has filed for a NYSE IPO (ticker CNTL, up to $100M sought, $157M revenue over the 12 months to end-June 2026): disc replacement, the alternative to spinal fusion, is becoming a listed category.

deal.thesis: Labcorp buys BioReference's (an OPKO subsidiary) laboratory assets: $722M in cash at closing and up to $150M of earn-out tied to revenue from the 4Kscore test (risk of aggressive prostate cancer, FDA-approved in 2021). Routine diagnostics consolidates while OPKO refocuses on biopharma.

brefsEurope.title: Panakès Partners raises €8.5M from Lombardia Venture STEP for a Lombard medtech and biotech vehicle
brefsEurope.summary: The new vehicle, funded by Lombardy's fund of funds, targets medtech and biotech companies in the region. Panakès is a life-sciences specialist whose first fund, launched in 2016, was dedicated to medtech.

brefsIntl.title: FDA grants Stryker 510(k) clearance for Sonopet 3, an ultrasonic platform for bone and soft-tissue resection
brefsIntl.summary: First clinical cases are planned this month, with a wider commercial launch later in the fall. New features: Pulse Control to tune hard- versus soft-tissue resection, and the integrated RISE workflow.

brefsIntl.title: Zimmer Biomet extends its exclusive distribution deal for Think Surgical's TMINI robot by several years
brefsIntl.summary: The wireless handheld TMINI robot, compatible with the Persona knee, targets surgeons who prefer a CT-based workflow, alongside Zimmer's own Rosa robot. Think has passed 5,000 TMINI procedures and raised $65M of growth capital.

brefsIntl.title: Olympus receives an FDA warning letter after inspection of six sites (US, Japan, Europe) and drops 13% in Tokyo
brefsIntl.summary: Received on October 7 and made public on the 13th, the letter cites quality-system deficiencies found in late 2025. Olympus promises a comprehensive response within 15 business days.

word.definition: An implant that replaces a degenerated intervertebral disc while preserving motion of the spinal segment, as an alternative to fusion (arthrodesis), which locks the vertebrae together.

how.t: The surgeon removes the degenerated disc and relieves the compressed nerve structures.
The prosthesis, chosen to match the patient's anatomy, is inserted between the two vertebrae.
The segment stays mobile instead of being fused, with the aim of sparing adjacent levels.

word.why: For a VC, this is a category validated through FDA PMA (one- then two-level approvals widen the addressable market) and that now has a listed exit: Centinel Spine is heading to the NYSE with $157M of trailing-12-month revenue. European players such as Spineart have a head start on clinical track record.

startups.name: Centinel Spine
startups.use: prodisc platform of cervical and lumbar disc prostheses, FDA-approved for one and two levels; NYSE IPO filing made (ticker CNTL, up to $100M).

startups.name: Spineart
startups.use: BAGUERA C cervical prosthesis, sold in Europe since 2008; CHF 20M convertible loan in 2024 and over €100M of revenue in 2023.

startups.name: Premia Spine
startups.use: TOPS lumbar facet arthroplasty system, another motion-preserving approach; FDA PMA approval with a superiority-to-fusion claim (77% success vs 24% in the pivotal trial, per the company).
